en.prefs.environment_parts: Hybrid single design with internal components (experimental)
en.prefs.environment_note: For new files. Single design keeps parts, sheet metal and assemblies together in one .sc file, as before. Hybrid keeps a design as one .sc file and lets it hold its parts inside as internal components, each with its own timeline, unpacked to a hidden folder beside the design while it is open. A new file can also be a part (.scprt), which may hold sheet metal, or an assembly (.scasm); a file keeps its kind.

en.missing_links.detail: These parts are not where their links say, nor in a library folder. They keep their last shape. Locate each one to point its link at the file.

en.prefs.update_linked_parts_note: Live reads a changed part when the assembly opens or its tab comes back. Update active only names it; Update Links brings it in.

vi.prefs.environment_parts: Chi tiết và cụm lắp (thử nghiệm)
